name: CyberChef
description: Browser-based toolbox for encoding, decoding, compression, hashing, parsing, encryption, and data transformation.
notes: Existing web frontend. Apache-2.0. Medium build; prefer for broad data-transformation/toolbox requests.

name: Stirling PDF
description: Locally hosted PDF toolkit for merging, splitting, converting, compressing, OCR, redaction, and other PDF operations.
notes: Existing web frontend. Heavy Docker app; select for a substantial PDF workspace, not a tiny one-off converter.

name: IT Tools
description: Collection of local developer utilities, converters, formatters, generators, and text/network helpers.
notes: Existing web frontend. Good fit for broad utility/toolbox requests.

name: Excalidraw
description: Open-source whiteboard for hand-drawn diagrams, flowcharts, sketches, and visual thinking.
notes: Existing web frontend. Large Node/TypeScript repo; choose for actual drawing/whiteboard requests.

name: yt-dlp
description: Cross-platform command-line media downloader supporting many video and audio sites.
notes: CLI-first Python tool. No official general GUI; generate a friendly frontend for URL, format, output folder, and subtitle options.

name: rembg
description: Background-removal tool and Python library for images.
notes: CLI/library capability. Generate a drag-and-drop image frontend when selected. Model assets may download on first use.

name: gallery-dl
description: Cross-platform command-line downloader for image galleries and collections from many supported sites.
notes: CLI-first Python tool. Generate a simple URL/options/download-folder UI. Upstream is also moving development toward Codeberg, so catalog health should be monitored.

name: OCRmyPDF
description: Adds searchable OCR text layers to scanned PDF files while preserving the original PDF structure.
notes: CLI-first Python tool with external OCR/system dependencies. Generate a file-upload UI; deployment may require extra container packages.

name: changedetection.io
description: Self-hosted website change monitor for content changes, price drops, restocks, and alerts.
notes: Existing web frontend. Prefer for persistent website-monitoring requests rather than a single fetch.

name: linkding
description: Minimal self-hosted bookmark manager with tagging, search, archiving, and browser-oriented workflows.
notes: Existing web frontend. Good fit for persistent personal bookmark/link-management requests.

name: Actual Budget
description: Local-first personal finance and budgeting application.
notes: Existing frontend; local-first. Broad finance product, so select only when the user wants a real budgeting/finance app rather than a tiny calculator.

name: Memos
description: Lightweight self-hosted Markdown-native note-taking and quick-capture application.
notes: Existing web frontend. Lightweight persistent notes product with SQLite-backed self-hosting.

name: Mealie
description: Self-hosted recipe manager, meal planner, and shopping-list application.
notes: Existing web frontend. Full persistent household app; heavier than generation for a tiny recipe form.

name: LibreTranslate
description: Self-hosted machine-translation API and web interface powered by open-source translation models.
notes: Existing web/API surface. Model downloads can be large; select when local/private translation is specifically valuable.

name: Karakeep
description: Self-hostable bookmark-everything app for links, notes, images, full-text search, and automatic tagging.
notes: Existing web frontend. Heavier than linkding; choose when rich capture/search/archival is requested.

name: SearXNG
description: Privacy-respecting self-hosted metasearch engine that aggregates results from multiple search services.
notes: Existing web frontend. Persistent service with external search-engine dependencies; use for private metasearch requests.

name: Calibre-Web
description: Web interface for browsing, reading, organizing, and downloading eBooks stored in a Calibre library.
notes: Existing web frontend. Best when the user already has or wants a persistent eBook library; some optional features need Calibre/Ghostscript.

name: Audiobookshelf
description: Self-hosted audiobook and podcast server with a full web interface.
notes: Existing web frontend. Persistent media service; select for library/server use cases, not one-off audio processing.

name: Immich
description: High-performance self-hosted photo and video management application.
notes: Existing web frontend but very heavy/multi-service. Choose only for full photo/video-library requests and expect container orchestration work.

name: Jellyfin
description: Personal media server for organizing and streaming movies, TV, music, and other media across devices.
notes: Complex persistent media server. Morfic uses Jellyfin’s official prebuilt container image to avoid source-build planning. Common local media folders are mounted read-only when present; external/custom folders still need a later folder-picker flow.

deployment_plan.name: Jellyfin
deployment_plan.summary: Personal media server using the official Jellyfin container image

name: WhoareYou
description: Private self-hosted relationship and family timeline app with household accounts, photos, family tree, comments, reactions, reminders, and guest sharing.
notes: Complex multi-user persistent app. Repository includes Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml and is designed for self-hosted family use. Requires container support and persistent database/media storage.

name: Cousins Matter
description: Self-hosted family social network with member profiles, galleries, forums, chat, events, polls, and private family content.
notes: Complex Docker-based family community app. Upstream reports Linux and Windows 11/WSL2 testing; macOS is not yet claimed upstream, so Morfic should treat macOS deployment as experimental until verified.
